summary: Master hospitality brand strategy, guest journey mapping, and reputation management. Drive asset value and guest loyalty with data-driven frameworks.
lede: Hospitality brand management gives commercial and operational professionals a structured way to differentiate hospitality offerings and deliver a consistent brand experience. Learners practice defining brand positioning, mapping guest journeys, managing brand portfolios, and applying quality assurance and reputation-management processes across digital channels and on-property service.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for mid-to-senior level professionals responsible for the commercial and operational success of hospitality assets.
modules: Hospitality Brand Foundations and Market Dynamics
Guest Persona Development and Journey Mapping
Digital Brand Presence and AI Integration
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3-5 years of experience in hospitality management, marketing, or operations. Familiarity with basic hotel performance metrics (RevPAR, ADR, Occupancy) is required. Pre-reading on current hospitality market trends will be provided.
